evidence.quote: it likely will be appropriate to maintain the current target range for the federal funds rate for a considerable time after the asset purchase program ends
In my view, the reasons would include the lingering effects of the financial crisis, including lower potential growth for a time.
these measured steps would continue and asset purchases would come to an end in the fourth quarter of this year.
forward guidance has generally been effective in providing support for the economy at a time when the federal funds rate has been pinned at its effective lower bound.
